entities.summary: Suliko Jgenti (1920–2000), credited also as Suliko Zhgenti, was a famous Georgian playwright and filmmaker. His movie Father of a Soldier became one of the popular movies in the former USSR. The movie tells the tragic story of a father who is searching for his son – a Soviet soldier during World War II.
